providers.removalCriteria: Local embedding is handled by a different mechanism (e.g. llama.cpp bindings) or removed from the feature set

providers.removalCriteria: Replaced by a different vector store (e.g. sqlite-vec, hnswlib-node) and all RAG pipelines migrated

providers.purpose: Layout-aware document ingestion (PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS, rich-text, Spotlight-indexable formats) via a Python sidecar provisioned through uv. Governed provider: install/health are probed, not assumed, and failure follows a declared degradation chain rather than crashing ingest.

versionPolicy.notes: Provisioned via uv-venv; no enforced version pin, version (if any) is reported by the health-check subprocess only.

healthCheck.detail: Runs the venv-installed `docling` console script directly (not `uv run`, which expects a pyproject-based project rather than a bare venv). A non-zero exit, timeout, or missing venv is unhealthy; stdout carries the docling/docling-core/docling-parse version lines.

chain.description: Layout-aware extraction (tables, OCR, all formats) via the local Python sidecar.
unpdf (PDF) or mammoth (DOCX) — pure-JS, lower fidelity, no OCR, no XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS support.
No extractor available for this format; ingest fails loud with an actionable install hint.

providers.removalCriteria: unknown (not recorded in lib/extensions/manifests/docling.manifest.json)

providers.purpose: React-based terminal UI renderer for interactive CLI components (progress, prompts, live output)

healthCheck.detail: require('ink') — absent means interactive TUI falls back to plain text output

providers.removalCriteria: TUI layer is removed from Construct or replaced with a different terminal rendering library

providers.purpose: YAML parsing for skill frontmatter, specialist manifests, scope configs, and ADR document headers
providers.securityConcerns: YAML parsing of untrusted input can trigger prototype pollution if safeLoad is not used; all usages must use yaml.load with schema: yaml.DEFAULT_SAFE_SCHEMA or yaml.safeLoad

healthCheck.detail: require('js-yaml') — verified at import time

providers.removalCriteria: YAML is replaced with TOML or JSON frontmatter across all documents and manifests

providers.purpose: DOCX document reading and conversion to HTML/markdown for document ingestion workflows
providers.securityConcerns: Parses untrusted DOCX files; DOCX is a ZIP-based format with macro and OLE object risks — mammoth does not execute macros but malformed XML could trigger parse errors

healthCheck.detail: require('mammoth') — absent means DOCX ingestion is unavailable; construct doctor warns

providers.removalCriteria: DOCX reading is handled by docling or another document processing pipeline

providers.removalCriteria: Postgres-backed shared storage is removed or replaced by a different SQL client/adapter

providers.purpose: Local audio/video transcription via whisper.cpp (Metal-accelerated on macOS). No npm dependency — the binary and model weights are provisioned outside npm and probed, not assumed.

versionPolicy.notes: Provisioned via system-binary; no enforced version pin, version (if any) is reported by the health-check subprocess only.

healthCheck.detail: whisper.cpp CLI has no --version flag; health runs the binary with --help and treats a clean exit (or the expected usage banner) as healthy. A missing binary or non-zero exit is unhealthy.

chain.description: No transcription backend available; audio/video ingest fails loud (ASR_REQUIRED) with an install hint (brew install whisper-cpp).

providers.removalCriteria: unknown (not recorded in lib/extensions/manifests/whisper.manifest.json)
